data.summary: Senior Business Analyst and Team Lead with 14+ years of experience in BFSI, Capital Markets, and Investment Banking domains. Experienced in program-level delivery, leading cross-functional Agile teams, and managing global stakeholders at Director and MD level across US, UK, and APAC geographies. Demonstrated ability to drive end-to-end business transformation programs, define solution strategy, and align technology roadmaps to business objectives. Expertise across the full BA lifecycle — Requirements Gathering, Gap Analysis, AS-IS TO-BE Analysis, Solution Scoping, UAT Management, and Traceability Matrix. Known for translating complex business problems into clear, actionable solutions that development teams can build, stakeholders can trust, and organizations can scale.

Conducted AS-IS discovery sessions and stakeholder interviews with onshore US/UK business sponsors at Director and MD level to capture High-Level Business Requirements and solution gaps.
Performed requirement prioritization using Moscow approach and Value/Effort analysis to recommend phasing of proposed solutions aligned to business priorities.
